title: Blueberry Lemon Cookie Bars With White Chocolate Drizzle
blurb: Despite the name these bake as drop cookies, not a sliced bar — the blueberries get folded in gently at the very end so they stay whole instead of bleeding into the dough.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, cream together the butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add the egg, vanilla extract, lemon zest and lemon juice, mixing until fully combined.

In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder and salt. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until a dough forms. Gently fold in the blueberries, being careful not to crush them.
Drop rounded portions of dough onto the prepared baking sheet, flattening slightly with the back of a spoon.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden and the centers are set. Cool on the baking sheet 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
Combine the white chocolate chips and heavy cream in a small microwave-safe bowl. Microwave in 15-second intervals, stirring in between, until fully melted and smooth.
Drizzle the glaze over the cooled cookies. Garnish with fresh blueberries and a sprinkle of lemon zest, and let the glaze set before serving.
